correctness.rationale: Stationary generator equations for four autonomous spins at delta=0 explicitly give E[XU]=4a/D, E[XV]=E[UY]=ab/D, E[XY]=0, E[UV]=4(a+b)/D, E[VY]=4b/D and E[XUVY]=ab/D. Algebra yields F0=−a²b²/D² and cumulant −2a²b²/D². Coupling by rate-two clocks and shared refresh/copy marks gives per-spin disagreement probability ≤delta, hence four-spin moment difference ≤8delta and each pair moment difference ≤4delta; triangle inequality gives |F_delta−F0|≤16delta, uniformly in size. For a=1/2,b=1/3, delta=10^-6, 16delta<1/9025. Stationary measures exist uniquely from nonzero refresh probability, and finite-state linear-generator computation at N=6 and N=9 cross-checks the exact rational values. Computation verifies only finite instances; generality is proved by local closure and graphical coupling.

originality.rationale: The most directly relevant fully inspected primary paper establishes the very ordered-pair factorization for exactly two alternating bath temperatures and explicitly asks if it extends to three or more. An autonomous four-spin exact calculation contradicts that form for a period-three bath pattern, and the coupling inequality moves the witness to three strictly finite distinct temperatures. Semantic claim comparisons of published findings, previously recorded mathematical claims, and targeted primary literature did not identify a theorem entailing this negative finite-bath defect. Residual risk is non-exhaustive historical search or broader multitemperature correlation representations; only direct ordered-two-point factorization is refuted.

value.rationale: The 2002 two-bath complete-solution paper explicitly leaves the n>2 temperature factorization question open. This theorem settles the direct ordered-pair version negatively with three different strictly finite baths, by an exact bounded four-spin witness and an all-size uniform stability radius. It isolates a structural failure of the equilibrium/alternating two-bath Ising correlation pattern, not a marginal numerical gain or arbitrary parameter slice. Exact rational witness and quantitative robustness allow any finite ring N divisible by three and infinite volume.
